steps.name: update-local-agent-bootstrap
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "0b971567942da9ae340e98bbe8bea422894b2b02"
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path("AGENTS.md")
text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
old = '''## Local Agent v4.6 — repository workflow

This repository is registered in the shared `MichalMatu/local-agent` v4.6 multi-repository supervisor.'''
new = '''## Local Agent — repository workflow

This repository is registered in the shared `MichalMatu/local-agent` multi-repository supervisor. Read the live daemon version, revision and execution model from `.agent/status/daemon.json` on `agent-control`; do not hard-code a Local Agent release number in this repository.'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit("expected Local Agent v4.6 header not found")
text = text.replace(old, new, 1)
marker = '''The canonical Local Agent implementation and operational documentation live in `MichalMatu/local-agent`. If the control protocol changes, update this bootstrap section so future chats do not depend on remembered conversation context.
'''
addition = marker + '''
For substantial coding tasks, prefer `workflow_policy: "efficient-verification-v1"` with explicit `work` / `focused` stages and exactly one final `full` verification stage. Task payloads are immutable: a claimed or interrupted task is not replayed automatically, so changed work or an intentional retry must use a new unique task id. A successful local task proves execution and verification; source publication remains an explicit final step.
'''
if marker not in text:
    raise SystemExit("canonical Local Agent paragraph not found")
text = text.replace(marker, addition, 1)
path.write_text(text, encoding="utf-8")
PY
git diff --check
git diff -- AGENTS.md

steps.name: verify-current-local-agent-contract
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
! grep -Fq 'v4.6' AGENTS.md
grep -Fq '.agent/status/daemon.json' AGENTS.md
grep -Fq 'efficient-verification-v1' AGENTS.md
grep -Fq 'claimed or interrupted task is not replayed automatically' AGENTS.md
git diff --check

verify_steps.name: publish-documentation-update
verify_steps.command:
set -euo pipefail
git diff --check
test "$(git diff --name-only)" = "AGENTS.md"
git add -- AGENTS.md
git diff --cached --check
git commit -m 'Update Local Agent workflow documentation'
git push origin HEAD:main
